body: ### Features - **General:** Honor proxy environment variables [#10168](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10168) - **General:** Validate port configuration values [#10166](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10166) - **scope:** Implements trace discarding via DD_TRACE_SAMPLING_RULES [#10104](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10104) ### Fixes - **AppSec:** Improve SQL and command evidence parsing [#10201](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10201) - **General:** Guard invalid text map carriers at input boundaries [#9980](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9980) - **General:** Use proxy for otlp export [#10176](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10176) - **Test Optimization:** Preserve Jest logger module realms [#10188](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10188) - **Test Optimization:** Retain delayed starts [#10185](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10185) - **Test Optimization:** Support version 1.63 [#10186](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10186) ### Internal (CI, Testing, Benchmarking) - **General:** Update @datadog/libdatadog to 0.21.0 [#10170](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10170) - **Test Optimization:** Gate Pino isolation test on Jest 28 [#10192](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10192) - **webdriverio:** Speed up integration test suite [#10193](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10193) ### Contributors [](https://github.com/bengl) [](https://github.com/BridgeAR) [](https://github.com/bwoebi) [](https://github.com/juan-fernandez) [](https://github.com/LotharSee)
